text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of computer science that helps machines understand human language. It allows computers to read and understand text, which is useful in many everyday situations. For example, NLP powers translation tools that change words from one language into another. It is also used for sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a review or comment is positive or negative. Another common use is chatbots, which talk with customers and answer their questions automatically. Thanks to NLP, technology can communicate with us in a more natural and helpful way.
